summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Sottovoce music translation app. Backend: 100% pass rate (16/16 tests). Frontend: All core features working correctly including manual entry, karaoke viewer with tabs, car mode, and history management.

backend_issues.notes: All backend endpoints working perfectly. Gemini integration for recognition and translation working as expected. Lyrics fetching from lrclib.net working correctly.

integration_issues.issue: Submit button remains disabled when using .fill() method in Playwright automated testing. Requires .type() method with delay to properly trigger React onChange events.
integration_issues.workaround: Use .type() instead of .fill() for form inputs in automated tests
integration_issues.note: This is a testing-specific issue, not a user-facing bug. Manual testing in browser works correctly.

passed_tests: Backend: GET /api/ returns 200
Backend: GET /api/languages returns 12 languages (Italian, English, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, Japanese, Chinese, Russian, Arabic, Dutch, Korean)
Backend: POST /api/lyrics with valid song (Imagine by John Lennon) - found with synced lyrics
Backend: POST /api/lyrics with garbage data - correctly returns found=false
Backend: POST /api/translate with valid lines - returns correct translations preserving order
Backend: POST /api/translate with empty lines - returns empty array
Backend: POST /api/track/manual with Italian - returns full TrackResolveResponse with 30 lines
Backend: POST /api/track/manual with Spanish - returns Spanish translations (verified)
Backend: POST /api/track/manual with non-existent song - returns valid response with empty lines
Backend: GET /api/history - returns array of history items
Backend: GET /api/history/{id} with valid ID - returns full TrackResolveResponse
Backend: GET /api/history/{id} with invalid ID - returns 404
Backend: DELETE /api/history/{id} - deletes single item
Backend: POST /api/recognize with imagine_lyrics.mp3 - correctly identified with confidence 1.0
Backend: POST /api/track/resolve with audio file - returns full track with Italian translations
Backend: DELETE /api/history - clears all history
Frontend: Splash page language picker displays 12+ languages
Frontend: Language selection and Continua button navigates to /home
Frontend: Home page displays all required elements (microphone button, manual entry button, cronologia button, language badge)
Frontend: Manual entry dialog opens and accepts title/artist input
Frontend: Manual entry form submission navigates to /result page with full track data
Frontend: Result page displays track info (title, artist, album, confidence, language)
Frontend: Karaoke tabs (Entrambi, Originale, Traduzione) all clickable and functional
Frontend: Tab switching works correctly (Originale shows only originals, Traduzione shows only translations, Entrambi shows both)
Frontend: Avvia karaoke button starts playback and changes to Pausa
Frontend: Karaoke timer increments correctly (0:00, 0:01, 0:02...)
Frontend: Modalità Auto button switches to full-screen car mode layout
Frontend: Car mode displays larger fonts and Esci button
Frontend: Esci button exits car mode and returns to normal view
Frontend: Cronologia page lists history items with title, artist, language, timestamp
Frontend: Clicking history item navigates to /result/{id}
Frontend: History items display with trash icons for deletion
Frontend: All /api prefix routes working correctly through Kubernetes ingress

additional_notes.gemini_integration: Both audio recognition (gemini-2.5-pro) and translation (gemini-2.5-flash) working correctly via Emergent LLM proxy
additional_notes.lrclib_integration: Lyrics fetching from lrclib.net working correctly with synced LRC format
additional_notes.italian_ui: All UI strings correctly in Italian as specified
additional_notes.pwa_features: App is responsive and works well on desktop. Car mode provides optimized layout for Android Auto displays
additional_notes.microphone_testing: Skipped as requested (browser automation cannot grant microphone permissions). Manual entry flow provides equivalent functionality for testing
additional_notes.audio_recognition_verified: Tested with /app/tests/poc_samples/imagine_lyrics.mp3 - correctly identified 'Imagine' by John Lennon with confidence 1.0
